messages:
jenny-cs: FYI forwarding a FinCorp request — they found a CVE in a transitive dependency of our hosted API container. They want: SBOM export, confirmation of patch/backport policy, and a remediation ETA for hosted + Dedicated + Private. Also asked about KMS audit evidence and whether rotation affects any key material.
elaine: Thanks. Can you paste the CVE ID and the service image tag they inspected?
samir: They sent CVE-2026-0421 and referenced image tag fincorp-scan:v2026-03-08. Looks like the vuln is in crypto-lib v2.1.0 (transitive via request-client).
security-bot: Automated triage: CVSS 7.8 (High). Affected component: crypto-lib < 2.1.3. Fix available upstream in 2.1.3. Impact: remote signature verification bypass in some cases.
mike: Quick answers for FinCorp: hosted API is pinned to base image rwinfer/hosted:2026-03-01 which includes crypto-lib v2.1.3 in layers? Need confirmation from CI SBOM.
elaine: I ran a local SBOM against the deployed image. Command I used:
```
syft docker:rwinfer/hosted:2026-03-01 -o json > sbom-hosted-20260308.json
```
Output shows crypto-lib 2.1.3 present in the image layer. So hosted runtime already contains upstream fix.
jenny-cs: FinCorp asked if that means "patched in hosted" and "what's the evidence" — they want a signed SBOM and a short remediation timeline for Dedicated and Private.
samir: For Dedicated: some pools still on older image (rwinfer/dedicated:2026-02-15) that includes crypto-lib 2.1.0. We have a rollout scheduled for 2026-03-12 to move Dedicated pools to 2026-03-01 baseline. ETA for full completion is 48 hours after rollout start for most regions.
mike: For Private (customer-managed) we can provide guidance and a patch bundle. Private customers must apply the image update themselves unless they are on managed-updates. For managed Private, we can schedule an orchestrated update — typical SLA is 5 business days depending on access window.
elaine: Evidence we can provide now: signed SBOM export for hosted image (I can sign with our release key), CI build logs showing dependency bump PR merged (link), and the security triage note.
elaine: Example snippet to generate signed SBOM locally (we'll generate server-side too):
```
syft docker:rwinfer/hosted:2026-03-01 -o json | cosign sign-blob -key cosign.key - > sbom-hosted-20260308.json.sig
```
jenny-cs: They also asked about KMS rotation. Do we rotate keys in a way that would impede evidence verification? FinCorp is worried rotation will break their attestations.
samir: Our KMS rotations rotate data keys; signing keys for releases are on HSM and rotated per policy but we retain old signing keys for verification windows. We can provide a signed statement from compliance that the release signing key used for the SBOM is retained for 12 months for verification.
mike: Also flagged: RBAC — FinCorp wants audit trail that shows who requested the Dedicated pool upgrade. We can export CloudAudit logs and a short timeline of the rollout approvals (approvals are in Confluence and our deployment system).
elaine: Proposed customer-facing reply (short):
"Hosted: patched (rwinfer/hosted:2026-03-01 includes fix). Attached: signed SBOM, CI PR link, triage note.
Dedicated: rollout planned 2026-03-12 -> expected completion within 48 hours after start; will provide per-region completion timestamps and audit logs of approval.
Private: if on managed-updates we can schedule within 5 business days; otherwise we will supply patched image + upgrade guide and SBOM.
KMS: release signing keys retained for verification; data key rotation does not affect SBOM verification. We'll include an attest copy from Compliance.
If you'd like, we can set up a short call with customer on Tuesday to walk through artifacts. :thumbsup: "
jenny-cs: I'll send that. Any objections?
samir: No objections. Suggest adding a note about mitigations in-place while Dedicated pools are upgraded: WAF rule, request rate limiting, and temporary fallback to software signature verification.
elaine: Added. Also attaching minimal redacted SOC2 coverage note as requested — redacted customer data removed.
mike: I'll prepare the signed SBOM and upload to the secure bucket, then share presigned link to FinCorp secure contact. ETA 2 hours.
security-bot: Artifact created: sbom-hosted-20260308.json.sig uploaded to s3://redwood-sec-evidence/2134567890/. Audit log entry id: audit-0a7c9f.
jenny-cs: Sent reply to FinCorp with artifacts and proposed schedule. They replied :eyes: and asked for per-region ETA for Dedicated — we'll follow up once rollout plan has exact times.
elaine: Filing a short post-incident note in the security incidents channel after the rollout completes documenting timeline and evidence artifacts.
jenny-cs: Thanks all — will close when FinCorp confirms. :white_check_mark:
